    // This matters for the large 3D MP4, which can outlast App's boot timer.
    if (!isLoading && mediaReady) {
      setFade(true);
      const timer = setTimeout(onFinish, 400);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isLoading, mediaReady, onFinish]);

  // Detect when the 3D MP4 can render. Use several readiness events because
  // WebView2 can emit `loadedmetadata` before a React effect attaches listeners.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loaderVideo || videoFailed) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return;

    const markReady = () => setVideoReady(true);
    const onError = () => {
      setVideoFailed(true);
      setVideoReady(true);
    };
    if (video.error) {
      onError();
      return;
    }
    if (video.readyState >= HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_CURRENT_DATA) {
      markReady();
    }
    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', markReady);
    video.addEventListener('loadeddata', markReady);
    video.addEventListener('canplay', markReady);
    video.addEventListener('canplaythrough', markReady);
    video.addEventListener('error', onError);
    return () => {
      video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', markReady);
      video.removeEventListener('loadeddata', markReady);
      video.removeEventListener('canplay', markReady);
      video.removeEventListener('canplaythrough', markReady);
      video.removeEventListener('error', onError);
    };
  }, [loaderVideo, videoFailed]);

  // React renders `muted` as an attribute but doesn't always set the DOM
  // property on mount, which can silently block muted-autoplay in WKWebView.
  // Set it imperatively and retry after metadata arrives so the MP4 starts
  // applied.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!useVideo) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video) return;
    const start = () => {
      video.muted = true;
      if (video.paused) video.play().catch(() => {});
    };
    start();
    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', start);
    video.addEventListener('canplay', start);
    return () => {
      video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', start);
      video.removeEventListener('canplay', start);
    };
  }, [useVideo]);

      .nb-compose .nb-input { border-color: transparent; background: transparent; caret-color: var(--nb-link); }

      .nb-chat-status { padding: 0 0 .15rem; }

- `tests/notebook/app-harness.html` + `tests/notebook/app-harness.tsx` render the **real `<App/>`** with `main.tsx`'s exact provider stack (`IngestionProvider` → `ChatLibraryProvider` → `DialogProvider` → `ErrorBoundary`) over a mocked Tauri bridge. > _Reasoning_
> Now I understand the theming. Key contrast problems visible from the tokens alone:
> 
> **Gloss light** (`--color-panel: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`, `--color-surface: rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`, `--color-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`) on a `#eeeeee` base:
> - White borders/panels on a near-white base → nearly invisible boundaries. Confirmed contrast problem.
> - `--color-text-hi: #0f172a` is dark → fine.
> - But `--color-slate-*` inverted → slate-900 = #fafafa (used as a dark bg in dark themes; in light it's light). Hmm.
> 
> **Gloss dark**: `--color-panel: rgba(15,15,15,0.35)` on `#121212` — very low contrast border `rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`.
> 
> **Glass light**: `--color-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.9)` — white border on `#e2e5ea` → invisible. Also `--color-panel: rgba(255,255,255,0.68)` on `#e2e5ea` — okay-ish for surface but borders invisible.
> 
> **Glass dark**: border rgba(255,255,255,0.12) — low but passable? Not great.
> 
> Now, the notebook currently uses `notebook-tokens.css` which **overrides** the theme tokens inside `.study-workspace`, `.study-assistant`, `.ai-panel`, `.ai-sidebar`, `.notebook-page`, `.model-picker__menu`, `.prompt-bar` with opaque, fixed `--nb-*` values per theme+mode. That was the previous session's fix for contrast — it forces opaque planes and readable text. So the notebook currently has contrast handled by those overrides.
>

> _Reasoning_
> Confirmed root cause: the global "Universal active-button text contrast" block forces `color: #0F172A !important` on any `button[aria-pressed="true"]`. This assumes pressed buttons always sit on the accent (orange/light) fill. In the notebook, `aria-pressed` is used for *toggle state* on neutral or dark surfaces (Cards/Grid toggle, panel tabs, Agent ON/OFF, Web toggle, tabs). So pressing them makes the text dark navy → invisible on dark surfaces.
> 
> This is precisely a "contrast issue" the user is hitting. The fix: scope this legacy rule so it doesn't apply inside the notebook/AI sidebar (which own their own pressed-state styling), same approach the previous session used for `.theme-glass button`.       .theme-glass .rounded:not(.rounded-none):not(.rounded-sm):not(.rounded-md):not(.rounded-lg):not(.rounded-xl):not(.rounded-2xl):not(.rounded-3xl):not(.rounded-4xl):not(.rounded-full) {

  content: |
      import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react';
      import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, BookOpen, Grid2X2, Layers, Plus, Search } from 'lucide-react';
      import type { Artifact, Collection } from '../../services/study';
      import './notebook-library.css';
      
      /** Collections remain the storage identity; covers are local, deterministic artwork. */
      function coverHue(id: string) { return [...id].reduce((hash, c) => (hash * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0, 17) % 360; }
      export function NotebookLibrary({ vaultPath, notebooks, materials, onOpen, onCreate, onLegacy }: {
        vaultPath: string; notebooks: Collection[]; materials: Artifact[]; onOpen: (id: string) => void; onCreate: () => void; onLegacy: () => void;
      }) {
        const [appearance, setAppearance] = useState(() => document.documentElement.className);
        useEffect(() => { const observer = new MutationObserver(() => setAppearance(document.documentElement.className)); observer.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); return () => observer.disconnect(); }, []);
        const industrial = appearance.includes('theme-industrial');
        const archetype = industrial ? 'industrial' : appearance.includes('theme-gloss') ? 'gloss' : 'glass';
        const key = `prism.notebook.library:${vaultPath}:${archetype}`;
        const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
        const [selected, setSelected] = useState('');
        const [mode, setMode] = useState('cards');
        const drag = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; moved: boolean } | null>(null);
        const track = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
        useEffect(() => { try { setMode(localStorage.getItem(key) || 'cards'); } catch { setMode('cards'); } }, [key]);
        const rows = notebooks.filter(n => n.title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query.toLocaleLowerCase()));
        const index = Math.max(0, rows.findIndex(n => n.id === selected));
        const active = rows[index];
        const select = (next: number) => { if (rows.length) setSelected(rows[Math.max(0, Math.min(rows.length - 1, next))].id); };
        useEffect(() => { if (industrial && mode === 'cards') track.current?.querySelector('[data-selected="true"]')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'center', behavior: 'instant' }); }, [selected, industrial, mode]);
        const changeMode = (value: string) => { setMode(value); try { localStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch { /* in-memory preference still works */ } };
        return <section className="notebook-library" aria-label="Notebook library">
          <header className="notebook-library__header"><div><span className="study-eyebrow">YOUR KNOWLEDGE, CONNECTED</span><h1>Notebooks</h1><p className="study-muted">A place for your sources, conversations, and study materials.</p></div><button onClick={onCreate}><Plus size={17}/> New notebook</button></header>
          <div className="notebook-library__controls"><label className="notebook-search"><Search size={17}/><input aria-label="Search notebooks" placeholder="Search notebooks…" value={query} onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}/></label><div aria-label="Library presentation"><button aria-pressed={mode === 'cards'} onClick={() => changeMode('cards')}><Layers size={16}/> Cards</button><button aria-pressed={mode === 'grid'} onClick={() => changeMode('grid')}><Grid2X2 size={16}/> Grid</button></div></div>
          {!rows.length ? <div className="study-empty"><BookOpen size={40}/><h2>{query ? 'No matching notebooks' : 'Start your first notebook'}</h2><p>{query ? 'Try a different title.' : 'Collect your notes and turn them into study materials.'}</p>{!query && <button onClick={onCreate}>Create notebook</button>}</div> : <>
            <div ref={track} className={`notebook-covers notebook-covers--${mode}`} data-industrial={industrial} role="group" aria-label="Notebook covers" tabIndex={mode === 'cards' ? 0 : -1}
              onKeyDown={e => { if (mode !== 'cards' || (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName === 'INPUT') return; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); select(index + (e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1)); } if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target === e.currentTarget) onOpen(active.id); }}
              onPointerDown={e => { if (mode === 'cards') drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, moved: false }; }}
              onPointerMove={e => { if (!drag.current) return; if (Math.abs(e.clientX - drag.current.x) > 12 && Math.abs(e.clientX - drag.current.x) > Math.abs(e.clientY - drag.current.y)) drag.current.moved = true; }}
              onPointerUp={e => { const start = drag.current; if (start?.moved) { select(index + Math.round((start.x - e.clientX) / 120 || (start.x > e.clientX ? 1 : -1))); e.preventDefault(); } setTimeout(() => { drag.current = null; }, 0); }} onPointerCancel={() => { drag.current = null; }}>
              {rows.map((notebook, i) => { const distance = i - index; const count = materials.filter(a => a.collectionId === notebook.id).length; return <button key={notebook.id} className="notebook-cover" data-selected={i === index} tabIndex={mode === 'grid' || i === index ? 0 : -1} aria-label={`${notebook.title}, ${notebook.sourceIds.length} sources, ${count} materials`} style={{ '--cover-hue': coverHue(notebook.id), '--cover-distance': distance, '--cover-depth': Math.abs(distance), zIndex: rows.length - Math.abs(distance) } as CSSProperties} onClick={() => { if (drag.current?.moved) return; if (mode === 'grid' || i === index) onOpen(notebook.id); else setSelected(notebook.id); }}>
                <span className="notebook-cover__art" aria-hidden="true"><span className="notebook-cover__orbit"/><BookOpen size={40}/><span className="notebook-cover__number">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span></span><span className="notebook-cover__caption"><strong>{notebook.title}</strong><small>{notebook.sourceIds.length} sources · {count} materials</small></span>
              </button>; })}
            </div>
            {mode === 'cards' && <footer className="notebook-library__caption"><button aria-label="Previous notebook" disabled={index === 0} onClick={() => select(index - 1)}><ArrowLeft size={18}/></button><div><h2>{active.title}</h2><p className="study-muted">{active.sourceIds.length} sources · {materials.filter(a => a.collectionId === active.id).length} materials</p><button onClick={() => onOpen(active.id)}>Open notebook <ArrowRight size={15}/></button></div><button aria-label="Next notebook" disabled={index === rows.length - 1} onClick={() => select(index + 1)}><ArrowRight size={18}/></button></footer>}
          </>}
          <footer className="notebook-library__secondary"><button onClick={onLegacy}>Advanced Notebook</button></footer>
        </section>;
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

      /* --- Search + presentation toggle ---------------------------------------- */
      .notebook-library__controls {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 12px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .notebook-library__controls > div {
        display: flex;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-library__controls > div > button {
        color: var(--nb-text);
        background: var(--nb-card);
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius-sm) !important;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-library__controls > div > button:hover {
        border-color: var(--nb-focus);
      }
      /* Pressed = selected segment. The tint and border carry the state; the label
         keeps full contrast (never dimmed or re-coloured to dark ink). */
      html .study-workspace .notebook-library__controls > div > button[aria-pressed='true'] {
        background: var(--nb-selection) !important;
        border-color: var(--nb-focus) !important;
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-search {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        flex: 1;
        max-width: 420px;
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-search input {
        width: 100%;
        color: var(--nb-text);
        background: var(--nb-card);
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius-sm) !important;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-search input::placeholder {
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
      }
      
      /* --- Cover track --------------------------------------------------------- */
      .notebook-covers {
        min-height: 300px;
        position: relative;
        flex: 1;
        perspective: 1200px;
        touch-action: pan-y;
        isolation: isolate;
      }
      .notebook-covers--cards {
        overflow: hidden;
        min-height: 320px;
      }

      }
      
      /* --- Cover card ---------------------------------------------------------- */
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover {
        padding: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        overflow: hidden;
        width: 240px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
        background: var(--nb-panel);
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--nb-shadow);
        transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.8, 0.25, 1), filter 0.25s ease,
          box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
        user-select: none;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover:hover {
        border-color: var(--nb-focus);
      }
      
      /* Cover artwork: dark by construction so the decorative overlay stays legible. */
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover__art {
        height: 240px;
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          hsl(var(--cover-hue) 34% 22%),
          hsl(calc(var(--cover-hue) + 45) 46% 10%)
        );
        color: #ffffff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover__orbit {
        position: absolute;
        width: 240px;
        height: 240px;
        border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.32);
        border-radius: 50% !important;
        transform: translate(70px, -45px);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 30px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04), 0 0 0 60px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035),
          0 0 0 90px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03);
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover__number {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 18px;
        left: 18px;
        font-size: 11px;
        letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        color: #ffffff;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover__caption {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 18px;
        min-width: 0;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: left;
        background-image: var(--nb-sheen);
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover__caption strong {
        font-size: 15px;
        color: var(--nb-text);
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover__caption small {
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
        font-size: 11px;
      }
      
      /* --- Coverflow (Glass + Gloss) ------------------------------------------- */
      .notebook-covers--cards:not([data-industrial='true']) .notebook-cover {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        top: 24px;
        transform: translateX(calc(-50% + var(--cover-distance) * 165px))
          translateZ(calc(var(--cover-depth) * -110px))
          rotateY(clamp(-48deg, calc(var(--cover-distance) * -38deg), 48deg));
        height: 270px;
      }
      .notebook-covers--cards:not([data-industrial='true']) .notebook-cover__art {
        height: 100%;
      }
      .notebook-covers--cards:not([data-industrial='true']) .notebook-cover__caption {
        display: none;
      }
      /* Depth cue without touching the coverflow transform (which positions the
         card) — the raised pane brightens and its edge warms to the focus colour. */
      .notebook-covers--cards:not([data-industrial='true']) .notebook-cover:hover {
        border-color: var(--nb-focus);
        filter: brightness(1.06);
      }
      
      /* --- Horizontal rail (Industrial) --------------------------------------- */
      .notebook-covers--cards[data-industrial='true'] {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 22px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
        padding: 16px 2px;
        touch-action: pan-x pan-y;
      }
      .notebook-covers--cards[data-industrial='true'] .notebook-cover {
        scroll-snap-align: center;
        height: 330px;
      }
      
      /* --- Selection ----------------------------------------------------------- */
      html .study-workspace .notebook-cover[data-selected='true'] {
        outline: 2px solid var(--nb-focus);
        outline-offset: 3px;
        border-color: var(--nb-focus);
      }
      
      /* --- Stationary caption -------------------------------------------------- */
      .notebook-library__caption {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 24px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .notebook-library__caption > div {
        text-align: center;
        max-width: 500px;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .notebook-library__caption h2 {
        font-size: 21px;
        color: var(--nb-text);
      }
      .notebook-library__secondary {
        margin-top: auto;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
      }
      
      /* --- Grid ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
      .notebook-covers--grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(220px, 100%), 1fr));
        gap: 24px;
        align-content: start;
        flex: none;
      }
      .notebook-covers--grid .notebook-cover {
        width: 100% !important;
      }
      .notebook-covers--grid .notebook-cover__art {
        height: 180px;
      }
      
      /* ==========================================================================
         Archetype treatment
         ========================================================================== */
      
      /* --- Industrial: precision drafting -------------------------------------- */
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-library h1 {
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      }
      /* Technical metadata: uppercase, tracked, monospaced. */
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-cover__caption small,
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-library__caption p,
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-library .study-eyebrow {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      }
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-cover__number {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
      }
      /* Flat opaque planes: no shadow at all, no lift — the sharp border is the
         only edge, and hover simply sharpens it to the focus colour. */
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-cover {
        box-shadow: none;
        backdrop-filter: none;
      }
      html.theme-industrial .study-workspace .notebook-covers--grid {
        gap: 18px;
      }
      
      /* --- Glass: rounded, frosted, lifting ------------------------------------ */
      html.theme-glass .study-workspace .notebook-cover {
        backdrop-filter: var(--nb-blur);
        box-shadow: var(--nb-edge), var(--nb-shadow);
      }
      html.theme-glass .study-workspace .notebook-covers--grid .notebook-cover:hover {
        transform: translateY(-4px);
      }
      html.theme-glass .study-workspace .notebook-cover__art {
        border-bottom: none;
      }
      html.theme-glass .study-workspace .notebook-cover__caption {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
      }
      
      /* --- Gloss: deepest translucency + specular sheen ------------------------ */
      html.theme-gloss .study-workspace .notebook-cover {
        backdrop-filter: var(--nb-blur);
        box-shadow: var(--nb-edge), var(--nb-shadow);
      }
      html.theme-gloss .study-workspace .notebook-covers--grid .notebook-cover:hover {
        transform: translateY(-6px);
      }
      html.theme-gloss .study-workspace .notebook-cover__art {
        border-bottom: none;
      }
      html.theme-gloss .study-workspace .notebook-cover__caption {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
      }
      
      /* --- Responsive ---------------------------------------------------------- */
      @container (max-width: 500px) {
        .notebook-library__header {
          align-items: flex-start;
          flex-direction: column;
        }
        .notebook-library__caption {
          gap: 12px;
        }
        .notebook-covers--cards {
          min-height: 290px;
        }
        .notebook-library__caption h2 {
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      }
      
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .notebook-cover {
          transition: none !important;
        }
        /* Neutralise the hover lift. The coverflow positioning transform is static
           layout (not motion) and must be preserved, so it is not targeted here. */
        .notebook-covers--grid .notebook-cover:hover {
          transform: none !important;
        }
        .notebook-covers--cards:not([data-industrial='true']) .notebook-cover:hover {
          filter: none !important;
        }
      }

**Things worth checking / flagged for you**

- **`--nb-edge` is unusable as written.** Industrial defines it as `none`, so any composition like `box-shadow: var(--nb-edge), var(--nb-shadow)` is invalid and the *entire* declaration is dropped — which silently kills focus rings. I therefore used `--nb-shadow` alone everywhere and did not apply `--nb-edge`. If you want the specular highlight in glass/gloss, either give industrial a render-nothing-but-valid value (e.g. `inset 0 0 0 0 transparent`) or apply `--nb-edge` alone on a separate `pointer-events:none` overlay. Same caution applies in `study.css`.
- `--nb-sheen` and `--nb-blur` are safe standalone (`none` is valid for both `background-image` and `backdrop-filter`).
- `study.css` still has `.study-flashcard .flip-card__face { background: var(--color-base) }`; my more specific rule overrides it (this preserves the previous specificity relationship, so no visual change), but you may want to delete it.
- I did not touch `PromptBar.tsx` or `FlipCard.tsx` — no className or markup change was needed.

- path: src/components/ui/FlipCard.css

      html .study-workspace .flip-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;gap:10px;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none}
      .flip-card__stage{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:120px;perspective:1400px;touch-action:pan-y;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--nb-radius)!important}
      .flip-card__rotor{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:rotateX(var(--tilt-x,0deg)) rotateY(var(--tilt-y,0deg));transition:transform .62s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1.08)}
      .flip-card[data-flipped] .flip-card__rotor{transform:rotateX(var(--tilt-x,0deg)) rotateY(calc(180deg + var(--tilt-y,0deg)))}
      html .study-workspace .flip-card__face{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:safe center;flex-direction:column;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,40px);background:var(--nb-card);color:var(--nb-text);border:1px solid var(--nb-border);border-radius:var(--nb-radius)!important;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 32px -20px #0008}
      .flip-card__face--back{transform:rotateY(180deg)}.flip-card__footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}.flip-card__face .study-card-text{margin:auto 0;padding:0;font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,30px);line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap}
      .theme-industrial .flip-card__rotor{--tilt-x:0deg!important;--tilt-y:0deg!important}.theme-gloss .flip-card__face{box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff60,0 16px 30px -18px #000a!important}
      @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.flip-card__rotor,.flip-card[data-flipped] .flip-card__rotor{transform:none;transition:none}.flip-card__face{transform:none;backface-visibility:visible}.flip-card__face[aria-hidden=true]{visibility:hidden}}

- path: src/components/ui/StatusMark.css
  content: |
      /* StatusMark — lifecycle glyph. Colors follow the shared brand/error ramps so
         every archetype and mode inherits its palette automatically; industrial
         flattens the round join via the global radius rule on the label chips. */
      .status-mark {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: calc(var(--sm-size, 16px) * 0.5);
        --sm-muted: 0.55;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .status-mark__glyph {
        flex: none;
        overflow: visible;
        color: var(--color-text-body);
        transition: color 200ms ease;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='running'] .status-mark__glyph {
        color: var(--color-brand-400);
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='done'] .status-mark__glyph {
        color: var(--status-done, #22c55e);
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='failed'] .status-mark__glyph {
        color: var(--status-error, #ef4444);
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='cancelled'] .status-mark__glyph {
        color: var(--color-text-body);
      }
      .status-mark__track {
        fill: none;
        stroke: currentColor;
        stroke-width: 2;
        stroke-opacity: 0.18;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='done'] .status-mark__track,
      .status-mark[data-status='failed'] .status-mark__track {
        fill: currentColor;
        fill-opacity: 0.06;
      }
      .status-mark__ring {
        fill: none;
        stroke: currentColor;
        stroke-width: 2;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        stroke-dasharray: 1.6 2.2;
        opacity: var(--sm-muted);
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='running'] .status-mark__ring,
      .status-mark[data-status='done'] .status-mark__ring,
      .status-mark[data-status='failed'] .status-mark__ring {
        stroke-dasharray: none;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='running'] .status-mark__ring {
        stroke-dasharray: 38 56.5;
        transform-origin: 12px 12px;
      }
      .status-mark[data-indeterminate] .status-mark__ring {
        animation: status-mark-spin 1.1s linear infinite;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='done'] .status-mark__ring,
      .status-mark[data-status='failed'] .status-mark__ring {
        stroke-dasharray: 56.5 56.5;
      }
      .status-mark__check,
      .status-mark__cross {
        fill: none;
        stroke: currentColor;
        stroke-width: 2;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
        stroke-dasharray: 1 2;
        stroke-dashoffset: 1.05;
        opacity: 0;
        transition:
          stroke-dashoffset 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1),
          opacity 0ms linear 220ms;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='done'] .status-mark__check,
      .status-mark[data-status='failed'] .status-mark__cross,
      .status-mark[data-status='cancelled'] .status-mark__cross {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
        transition:
          stroke-dashoffset 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) 120ms,
          opacity 0ms linear 120ms;
      }
      .status-mark__label {
        color: var(--color-text-hi);
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.35;
        transition: color 200ms ease, opacity 200ms ease;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='done'] .status-mark__label {
        color: var(--color-text-body);
        opacity: 0.75;
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='cancelled'] .status-mark__label {
        color: var(--color-text-body);
      }
      .status-mark[data-status='failed'] .status-mark__label {
        color: var(--color-text-hi);
      }
      .status-mark__sr {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      
      @keyframes status-mark-spin {
        to {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }
      
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .status-mark[data-indeterminate] .status-mark__ring {
          animation: status-mark-breathe 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .status-mark__check,
        .status-mark__cross {
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          transition: opacity 200ms ease;
        }
      }
      @keyframes status-mark-breathe {
        50% {
          opacity: 0.4;
        }
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

- path: src/components/ui/notebook-tokens.css
  content: |
      /* ==========================================================================
         Notebook surface contract
         --------------------------------------------------------------------------
         One set of semantic tokens, resolved six ways: Industrial precision,
         Liquid Glass (rounded) and Liquid Gloss, each in light and dark.
      
         Rules this file exists to enforce:
         1. Text never drops below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text) against the surface it
            is actually composited over — including translucent glass/gloss planes,
            whose effective colour is resolved against the canvas behind them.
         2. Menus and reading surfaces get an opaque-enough backing so content can
            never bleed through and destroy legibility.
         3. Appearance changes geometry, depth and edge treatment. It never changes
            text opacity, and it never disables a whole component to signal state.
         ========================================================================== */
      
      /* --- Shared geometry tokens (overridden per archetype below) -------------- */
      :root {
        --nb-radius: 16px;
        --nb-radius-sm: 8px;
        --nb-blur: none;
        --nb-edge: inset 0 0 0 1px transparent;
        --nb-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);
        --nb-sheen: none;
        --nb-accent-ink: #0b0e13;
        /* Fallback palette (Industrial dark) so the notebook is still legible if it
           is ever mounted before a theme class is applied to <html>. */
        --nb-canvas: #0f1216;
        --nb-panel: #171b21;
        --nb-card: #1f242c;
        --nb-menu: #232a33;
        --nb-text: #f4f6fa;
        --nb-secondary: #bbc5d3;
        --nb-border: #5f6c7e;
        --nb-focus: #8ec5ff;
        --nb-selection: #23303f;
      }
      
      /* ==========================================================================

- path: src/components/ui/PromptBar.css
  content: |
      /* PromptBar — the shared composer behind Notebook chat, the legacy Notebook
         chat and the AI sidebar.
      
         The composer is the primary input surface, so it carries the archetype's
         full surface treatment: flat hairline (industrial), frosted pane (glass) or
         a sheened, deeply translucent pane (gloss). Focus is a thin accent edge plus
         a visible caret — never a glow that drowns the text. */
      
      html .prompt-bar {
        position: relative;
        flex: none;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 12px !important;
        margin: 6px 0 0;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
        background-color: var(--nb-card) !important;
        background-image: var(--nb-sheen) !important;
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--nb-blur);
        backdrop-filter: var(--nb-blur);
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border) !important;
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--nb-shadow) !important;
        color: var(--nb-text);
      }
      
      /* Focus: a 2px accent rule along the bottom edge, so the composer never turns
         into a bright box. Declared as a single shadow value: composing it with
         --nb-shadow would be invalid in Industrial, where that token is `none`,
         and would drop the focus indicator entirely. */
      html .prompt-bar:focus-within {
        border-color: var(--nb-focus) !important;
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 var(--nb-focus) !important;
      }
      
      html .prompt-bar textarea {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 24px !important;
        max-height: 120px;
        line-height: 24px !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border: 0 !important;
        border-radius: 0 !important;
        background: transparent !important;
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 13px;
        resize: none;
        overflow-y: auto;
        caret-color: var(--nb-focus);
        box-shadow: none !important;
        outline: none !important;
      }
      html .prompt-bar textarea::placeholder {
        color: var(--nb-secondary) !important;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      html .prompt-bar textarea:focus,
      html .prompt-bar textarea:focus-visible {
        outline: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
      }
      
      .prompt-bar__controls {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 6px;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .prompt-bar__context {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
        min-width: 0;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .prompt-bar__spacer {
        flex: 1;
      }
      
      html .prompt-bar__controls button {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
        background: var(--nb-panel);
        color: var(--nb-text);
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 11px;
        padding: 6px 8px;
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius-sm) !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        min-height: 30px;
        max-width: 100%;
        white-space: normal;
      }
      html .prompt-bar__controls button:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background: var(--nb-selection);
        border-color: var(--nb-focus);
      }
      .prompt-bar__controls .model-picker {
        max-width: 100%;
      }
      
      /* Pressed toggles (Agent ON/OFF, Web) sit on neutral panes, not on the accent,
         so they read with the primary ink over a selection tint. */
      html .prompt-bar__controls button[aria-pressed='true'] {
        background: var(--nb-selection) !important;
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
        border-color: var(--nb-focus) !important;
      }
      
      /* Accent action tile: ink is derived from the accent's luminance. */
      html .prompt-bar__controls .prompt-bar__send {
        width: 34px;
        height: 34px;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 0;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        background: var(--color-brand-400) !important;
        color: var(--nb-accent-ink) !important;
        border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-400) 70%, var(--nb-border)) !important;
      }
      html .prompt-bar__controls .prompt-bar__send svg {
        color: inherit !important;
      }
      html .prompt-bar__controls .prompt-bar__send:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background: var(--color-brand-500) !important;
      }
      
      /* Disabled controls dim the chrome, never the label. */
      html .prompt-bar__controls button:disabled {
        opacity: 1;
        color: var(--nb-secondary) !important;
        background: var(--nb-panel) !important;
        border-color: var(--nb-border) !important;
        cursor: not-allowed;
      }
      
      .prompt-bar [role='alert'] {
        color: var(--nb-text);
        font-size: 11px;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .model-picker__error {
        font-size: 11px;
        max-width: 220px;
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
      }
      
      /* Industrial precision: the composer is a flat ruled plate with no radius. */
      .theme-industrial .prompt-bar {
        box-shadow: none !important;
      }
      
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        html .prompt-bar {
          transition: none;
        }
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: src/components/ui/FlipCard.css
  content: |
      /* FlipCard — the flashcard reading surface.
      
         Both faces are full reading planes, so they take the archetype's surface
         (flat plate / frosted pane / sheened translucent pane) and must keep their
         text at full contrast. Behaviour (whole-surface 3D rotation, pointer tilt
         variables, backface hiding, reduced-motion fallback) is unchanged. */
      
      html .study-workspace .flip-card {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        width: 100%;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 0;
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      .flip-card__stage {
        position: relative;
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 120px;
        perspective: 1400px;
        touch-action: pan-y;
        cursor: pointer;
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius) !important;
      }
      .flip-card__rotor {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        transform-style: preserve-3d;
        transform: rotateX(var(--tilt-x, 0deg)) rotateY(var(--tilt-y, 0deg));
        transition: transform 0.62s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1.08);
      }
      .flip-card[data-flipped] .flip-card__rotor {
        transform: rotateX(var(--tilt-x, 0deg)) rotateY(calc(180deg + var(--tilt-y, 0deg)));
      }
      
      html .study-workspace .flip-card__face {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: stretch;
        justify-content: safe center;
        flex-direction: column;
        overflow: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
        padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 40px);
        background-color: var(--nb-card);
        background-image: var(--nb-sheen);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--nb-blur);
        backdrop-filter: var(--nb-blur);
        color: var(--nb-text);
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius) !important;
        backface-visibility: hidden;
        -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
        box-shadow: var(--nb-shadow);
      }
      .flip-card__face--back {
        transform: rotateY(180deg);
      }
      .flip-card__footer {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 8px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .flip-card__face .study-card-text {
        margin: auto 0;
        padding: 0;
        font-size: clamp(19px, 2vw, 30px);
        line-height: 1.6;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        color: var(--nb-text);
      }
      
      /* Industrial precision: rigid plate, no hover tilt. The face lift already
         resolves to `none` there through --nb-shadow. */
      .theme-industrial .flip-card__rotor {
        --tilt-x: 0deg !important;
        --tilt-y: 0deg !important;
      }
      
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .flip-card__rotor,
        .flip-card[data-flipped] .flip-card__rotor {
          transform: none;
          transition: none;
        }
        .flip-card__face {
          transform: none;
          backface-visibility: visible;
        }
        .flip-card__face[aria-hidden='true'] {
          visibility: hidden;
        }
      }

1. **Fixed the dropdown's illegibility / blending.** The menu previously painted itself with `background: var(--color-panel)` — an in-page surface that is translucent in glass (`rgb(18 20 24 / 0.72)`) and gloss (`rgb(15 15 15 / 0.35)`), so page content behind the portaled menu bled through. The menu's background, border, radius, shadow, `overflow-y` and `overscroll-behavior` are now supplied by the contract's opaque floating plane (`--nb-menu` plus `--nb-border` / `--nb-radius-sm` / `--nb-shadow` + `--nb-edge`), so I deleted those declarations from this file rather than fighting the token block with `!important`.

2. **Removed the archived `rgb()` chrome rules.** The old `.theme-glass/.theme-gloss .model-picker__menu` block hardcoded `rgba(0,0,0,0.6)` shadows and `14px`/`10px` radii, duplicating what the tokens now express per archetype; deleted, so the file contains **no raw colour literals** for chrome. Archetype differences now flow entirely from tokens — industrial gets 0px radius / no blur / no glow, glass 10px + specular edge, gloss 12px + deepest shadow.

3. **Tokenised all text so labels and descriptions pass contrast.** Option names were `var(--color-text-hi)` and are now `--nb-text`; descriptions, tags and the trigger label were `var(--color-text-body)` and are now `--nb-secondary` — both defined per archetype+mode against the surface they sit on. The active/selected row uses `--nb-selection` (from the contract block) with `--nb-text`, so the label stays readable while tinted.

4. **Two genuine contrast defects corrected:**
   - The selected checkmark used `--color-brand-400`. The accent is user-configurable, and a bright sky accent on a light selection tint fails; it now rides `--nb-focus`, which is tuned per archetype and mode to stay visible on its own surface.
   - The unrecognised-model state (`data-unavailable`) was drawn in accent ink, which is unreadable on light themes. It is now `--nb-text` with a dotted underline, so colour is not the only signal — a behaviour-visible but non-structural change worth an eyeball.

5. Also dropped the chevron's `opacity: 0.7` (it inherits `currentColor`, so it now matches the token ink exactly) and removed a duplicated `.model-picker__error` rule that the contract block and `PromptBar.css` already own.

**Left undone / worth checking by the coordinator:** the menu now relies on `notebook-tokens.css` for its background entirely — correct today because `ModelPicker.tsx` imports it, but if that import is ever dropped the popover renders transparent. I did not add per-archetype `--nb-sheen` to the menu: the contract sets the menu's `background` with `!important`, so a sheen would need a competing `!important` override, and the archetype depth already comes through `--nb-edge`/`--nb-shadow`. Visual confirmation of the dropdown across all six appearances is still needed, since I could not run the contrast audit.

  content: |
      /* ModelPicker — compact combobox for prompt bars. Surfaces and geometry adapt
         to the active design archetype through the shared color tokens and the
         archetype radius rules (industrial flattens everything globally). */
      .model-picker {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 1 auto;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .model-picker__trigger {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        max-width: 100%;
        height: 28px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--color-text-body);
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 500;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .model-picker__trigger:hover {
        background: var(--color-surface-hover);
        border-color: var(--color-border);
      }
      .model-picker__trigger[data-unavailable] {
        color: var(--color-brand-400);
      }
      .model-picker__current {
        overflow: hidden;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .model-picker__chevron {
        flex: none;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        border-right: 3.5px solid transparent;
        border-left: 3.5px solid transparent;
        border-top: 4px solid currentColor;
        opacity: 0.7;
      }
      .model-picker__menu {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 120;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
        min-width: 200px;
        max-width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 24px));
        padding: 5px;
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: var(--color-panel);
        box-shadow: 0 14px 36px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
        transform: translateY(-100%);
        transform-origin: bottom left;
        animation: model-picker-pop 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) both;
      }
      .model-picker__menu[data-below] {
        transform: none;
        transform-origin: top left;
      }
      .model-picker__menu[data-align='end'] {
        transform-origin: bottom right;
      }
      .model-picker__menu[data-align='end'][data-below] {
        transform-origin: top right;
      }
      @keyframes model-picker-pop {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
        }
      }
      .model-picker__option {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        min-height: 34px;
        padding: 5px 8px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        color: var(--color-text-hi);
        font-size: 12px;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .model-picker__option[data-active] {
        background: var(--color-surface-hover);
      }
      .model-picker__check {
        flex: none;
        width: 12px;
        height: 12px;
      }
      .model-picker__option[aria-selected='true'] .model-picker__check::after {
        content: '';
        display: block;
        width: 5px;
        height: 9px;
        margin: -1px 0 0 3px;
        border-right: 2px solid var(--color-brand-400);
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-brand-400);
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }
      .model-picker__names {
        display: grid;
        min-width: 0;
        flex: 1 1 auto;
      }
      .model-picker__name {
        overflow: hidden;
        font-weight: 550;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .model-picker__desc {
        overflow: hidden;
        color: var(--color-text-body);
        font-size: 10px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .model-picker__tag {
        flex: none;
        color: var(--color-text-body);
        font-size: 10px;
        text-transform: capitalize;
      }
      
      /* Archetype polish: glass/gloss float a softer, rounder popover; industrial
         keeps the flat hard-edged surface defined above. */
      .theme-glass .model-picker__menu,
      .theme-gloss .model-picker__menu {
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 48px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-border);
      }
      .theme-glass .model-picker__option,
      .theme-gloss .model-picker__option {
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .model-picker__menu {
          animation: none;
        }
      }

- path: src/components/ui/notebook-tokens.css
  content: |
      /* ==========================================================================
         Notebook surface contract
         --------------------------------------------------------------------------
         One set of semantic tokens, resolved six ways: Industrial precision,
         Liquid Glass (rounded) and Liquid Gloss, each in light and dark.
      
         Rules this file exists to enforce:
         1. Text never drops below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text) against the surface it
            is actually composited over — including translucent glass/gloss planes,
            whose effective colour is resolved against the canvas behind them.
         2. Menus and reading surfaces get an opaque-enough backing so content can
            never bleed through and destroy legibility.
         3. Appearance changes geometry, depth and edge treatment. It never changes
            text opacity, and it never disables a whole component to signal state.
         ========================================================================== */
      
      /* --- Shared geometry tokens (overridden per archetype below) -------------- */
      :root {
        --nb-radius: 16px;
        --nb-radius-sm: 8px;
        --nb-blur: none;
        --nb-edge: inset 0 0 0 1px transparent;
        --nb-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18);
        --nb-sheen: none;
        --nb-accent-ink: #0b0e13;
        /* Fallback palette (Industrial dark) so the notebook is still legible if it
           is ever mounted before a theme class is applied to <html>. */
        --nb-canvas: #0f1216;
        --nb-panel: #171b21;
        --nb-card: #1f242c;
        --nb-menu: #232a33;
        --nb-text: #f4f6fa;
        --nb-secondary: #bbc5d3;
        --nb-border: #5f6c7e;
        --nb-focus: #8ec5ff;
        --nb-selection: #23303f;
      }
      
      /* ==========================================================================
         1. INDUSTRIAL — precision drafting. Opaque planes, square corners, hairline
         borders, no blur, no sheen. Contrast comes from flat, solid surfaces.
         ========================================================================== */
      :root.theme-industrial {
        --nb-radius: 0px;
        --nb-radius-sm: 0px;
        --nb-blur: none;
        --nb-edge: none;
        --nb-shadow: none;
        --nb-sheen: none;
      }
      :root.theme-industrial.mode-dark {
        --nb-canvas: #0f1216;
        --nb-panel: #171b21;
        --nb-card: #1f242c;
        --nb-menu: #232a33;
        --nb-text: #f4f6fa;
        --nb-secondary: #bbc5d3;
        --nb-border: #5f6c7e;
        --nb-focus: #8ec5ff;
        --nb-selection: #23303f;
      }
      :root.theme-industrial.mode-light {
        --nb-canvas: #e9ebee;
        --nb-panel: #ffffff;
        --nb-card: #f4f6f8;
        --nb-menu: #ffffff;
        --nb-text: #101520;
        --nb-secondary: #46536a;
        --nb-border: #75808f;
        --nb-focus: #1f4ea8;
        --nb-selection: #dde6f4;
      }
      
      /* ==========================================================================
         2. LIQUID GLASS — rounded, frosted. Soft translucent panes lifted off the
         canvas by a specular top edge and a wide, low-contrast shadow.
         ========================================================================== */
      :root.theme-glass {
        --nb-radius: 16px;
        --nb-radius-sm: 10px;
        --nb-blur: blur(18px) saturate(165%);
        --nb-edge: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06);
        --nb-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55);
        --nb-sheen: none;
      }
      :root.theme-glass.mode-dark {
        --nb-canvas: #0a0c10;
        --nb-panel: rgb(26 30 37 / 0.78);
        --nb-card: rgb(38 44 54 / 0.72);
        --nb-menu: rgb(28 33 41 / 0.97);
        --nb-text: #ffffff;
        --nb-secondary: #cbd5e1;
        --nb-border: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.24);
        --nb-focus: #8ec5ff;
        --nb-selection: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16);
      }
      :root.theme-glass.mode-light {
        --nb-canvas: #dfe4ec;
        --nb-panel: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.78);
        --nb-card: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92);
        --nb-menu: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.98);
        --nb-text: #0c1220;
        --nb-secondary: #3f4c60;
        --nb-border: rgb(30 41 59 / 0.26);
        --nb-focus: #1f4ea8;
        --nb-selection: rgb(31 78 168 / 0.14);
        --nb-edge: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.05);
        --nb-shadow: 0 10px 28px -20px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.45);
      }
      
      /* ==========================================================================
         3. LIQUID GLOSS — deepest translucency, the largest radii, a specular
         highlight band across the top of raised panes and a heavier drop shadow.
         ========================================================================== */
      :root.theme-gloss {
        --nb-radius: 20px;
        --nb-radius-sm: 12px;
        --nb-blur: blur(26px) saturate(150%);
        --nb-edge: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.32), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07);
        --nb-shadow: 0 22px 48px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.62);
        --nb-sheen: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12), rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 42%);
      }
      :root.theme-gloss.mode-dark {
        --nb-canvas: #0d0e12;
        --nb-panel: rgb(24 25 32 / 0.66);
        --nb-card: rgb(40 42 54 / 0.62);
        --nb-menu: rgb(30 32 41 / 0.97);
        --nb-text: #ffffff;
        --nb-secondary: #cfd6e2;
        --nb-border: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28);
        --nb-focus: #8ec5ff;
        --nb-selection: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18);
      }
      :root.theme-gloss.mode-light {
        --nb-canvas: #e8e9ef;
        --nb-panel: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.64);
        --nb-card: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.78);
        --nb-menu: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.98);
        --nb-text: #0b1020;
        --nb-secondary: #3b4757;
        --nb-border: rgb(30 41 59 / 0.28);
        --nb-focus: #1f4ea8;
        --nb-selection: rgb(31 78 168 / 0.16);
        --nb-edge: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08);
        --nb-shadow: 0 18px 44px -26px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.5);
        --nb-sheen: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55), rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 46%);
      }
      
      /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
         Remap the host app tokens inside every notebook-owned subtree so Tailwind
         utility classes (used by the shared chat and the AI sidebar) inherit the
         same legible palette instead of the shell's translucent one.
         -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar, .ai-panel, .notebook-page, .prompt-bar, .model-picker__menu) {
        --color-base: var(--nb-canvas);
        --color-panel: var(--nb-panel);
        --color-surface: var(--nb-card);
        --color-surface-hover: var(--nb-selection);
        --color-border: var(--nb-border);
        --color-text-hi: var(--nb-text);
        --color-text-body: var(--nb-secondary);
        --color-text-muted: var(--nb-secondary);
        --color-offwhite: var(--nb-text);
        color: var(--nb-text);
      }
      
      /* Disabled controls stay legible: dim the chrome, never the label. */
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar) :is(button, input, select, textarea):disabled {
        opacity: 1;
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
        border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nb-border) 70%, transparent);
        cursor: not-allowed;
      }
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar) :is(input, textarea)::placeholder {
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
        opacity: 1;
      }
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar) :focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--nb-focus);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
      
      /* The universal app rule forces dark ink on every pressed button, which only
         holds when the fill is the accent. Notebook toggles sit on neutral and
         translucent surfaces, so the subtree opts out and styles itself. */
      html body :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar, .prompt-bar)
        :is(button[aria-pressed='true'], button[aria-selected='true'], button[role='tab'][aria-selected='true']) {
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
      }
      
      /* Tailwind text utilities inside the shared surfaces resolve to the palette. */
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar)
        :is(.text-slate-100, .text-slate-200, .text-slate-300, .text-offwhite, .text-white) {
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
      }
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar)
        :is(.text-slate-400, .text-slate-500, .text-slate-600, .text-text-muted) {
        color: var(--nb-secondary) !important;
      }
      html :is(.study-workspace, .study-assistant, .ai-sidebar)
        :is(.bg-slate-800, .bg-slate-900, .bg-slate-950, .bg-panel) {
        background: var(--nb-card) !important;
      }
      
      /* Portaled / floating surfaces are opaque enough to read over any content. */
      html .model-picker__menu {
        background: var(--nb-menu) !important;
        color: var(--nb-text);
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border);
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius-sm) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--nb-shadow), var(--nb-edge);
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
      }
      html .model-picker__option {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
        border-radius: calc(var(--nb-radius-sm) * 0.6) !important;
      }
      html .model-picker__option:is([data-active], [aria-selected='true']) {
        background: var(--nb-selection) !important;
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
      }
      html .model-picker__error {
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
      }
      
      /* Accent-filled primary actions take ink derived from the accent luminance. */
      html :is(.study-send, .study-primary, .prompt-bar__send) {
        background: var(--color-brand-400) !important;
        color: var(--nb-accent-ink) !important;
        border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-400) 70%, var(--nb-border)) !important;
      }
      html :is(.study-send, .study-primary, .prompt-bar__send) svg {
        color: inherit !important;
      }
      
      /* Reading surfaces and status text never animate their own legibility. */
      html .ai-status-line__label {
        color: var(--nb-secondary);
        background: none;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: currentColor;
        animation: none;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      html .study-table th {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        background: var(--nb-panel);
        z-index: 1;
      }
      html .study-area-tabs button[aria-pressed='true'] {
        background: var(--nb-selection);
        color: var(--nb-text);
        border-color: var(--nb-focus);
      }
      html .prism-navigation-trigger {
        color: var(--nb-text) !important;
        background: var(--nb-panel) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--nb-border) !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        border-radius: var(--nb-radius-sm) !important;
      }
      html .ai-sidebar {
        background: var(--nb-panel) !important;
        color: var(--nb-text);
      }
      
      :root.mode-light {
        --status-done: #14653a;
        --status-error: #a81b2b;
      }
      .study-task-status {
        max-height: 180px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        overflow: auto;
      }
      .study-task-row {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .study-task-actions {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      
      /* Library/workspace mount wrapper (layout owned by the study workspace). */
      .study-workspace__body {
        display: flex;
        flex: 1;
        flex-direction: column;
        min-height: 0;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .study-workspace__body[hidden] {
        display: none !important;
      }

{
  "path": "src/components/ui/ModelPicker.css",
  "instructions": "Rebuild the model picker CSS on the notebook token contract with token-driven chrome.",
  "content": "/* ModelPicker — compact combobox for the shared prompt bars.\n   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n   The dropdown is portaled, so it floats over arbitrary application content.\n   It therefore takes the notebook contract's *opaque* floating-menu plane\n   (--nb-menu) instead of an in-page translucent surface, which is what made it\n   previously blend into the content behind it.\n\n   Colour, shape and depth are supplied by the token contract in\n   notebook-tokens.css (which owns the `html .model-picker__menu/__option/__error`\n   rules). This file contributes only structure — layout, spacing, the chevron\n   and the selected checkmark — so each archetype stays distinct without\n   duplicating declarations:\n     industrial  square corners, flat plane, crisp hairline, no glow\n     glass       rounded, frosted, soft specular top edge\n     gloss       largest radius, deepest glow\n   */\n\n.model-picker {\n  position: relative;\n  display: inline-flex;\n  flex: 0 1 auto;\n  min-width: 0;\n}\n\n.model-picker__trigger {\n  display: inline-flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 5px;\n  max-width: 100%;\n  height: 28px;\n  padding: 0 8px;\n  border: 1px solid transparent;\n  border-radius: var(--nb-radius-sm, 8px);\n  background: transparent;\n  color: var(--nb-secondary, var(--color-text-body));\n  font: inherit;\n  font-size: 11px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n.model-picker__trigger:hover {\n  background: var(--nb-selection, var(--color-surface-hover));\n  border-color: var(--nb-border, var(--color-border));\n  color: var(--nb-text, var(--color-text-hi));\n}\n/* A saved model that is no longer in the registry stays fully legible; the\n   dotted underline carries the state so colour is not the only signal. */\n.model-picker__trigger[data-unavailable] {\n  color: var(--nb-text, var(--color-text-hi));\n  text-decoration: underline dotted;\n  text-underline-offset: 3px;\n}\n.model-picker__current {\n  overflow: hidden;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n.model-picker__chevron {\n  flex: none;\n  width: 0;\n  height: 0;\n  border-right: 3.5px solid transparent;\n  border-left: 3.5px solid transparent;\n  border-top: 4px solid currentColor;\n}\n\n/* Positioning and scroll containment only — the plane itself is token-driven. */\n.model-picker__menu {\n  position: fixed;\n  z-index: 120;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 2px;\n  min-width: 200px;\n  max-width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 24px));\n  padding: 5px;\n  transform: translateY(-100%);\n  transform-origin: bottom left;\n  animation: model-picker-pop 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) both;\n}\n.model-picker__menu[data-below] {\n  transform: none;\n  transform-origin: top left;\n}\n.model-picker__menu[data-align='end'] {\n  transform-origin: bottom right;\n}\n.model-picker__menu[data-align='end'][data-below] {\n  transform-origin: top right;\n}\n@keyframes model-picker-pop {\n  from {\n    opacity: 0;\n  }\n}\n\n.model-picker__option {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 8px;\n  min-height: 34px;\n  padding: 5px 8px;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n.model-picker__option:hover {\n  background: var(--nb-selection, var(--color-surface-hover));\n}\n.model-picker__check {\n  flex: none;\n  width: 12px;\n  height: 12px;\n}\n/* The check rides the focus ink, which is tuned per archetype and mode to stay\n   visible on the selected row's tint. */\n.model-picker__option[aria-selected='true'] .model-picker__check::after {\n  content: '';\n  display: block;\n  width: 5px;\n  height: 9px;\n  margin: -1px 0 0 3px;\n  border-right: 2px solid var(--nb-focus, var(--color-brand-400));\n  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--nb-focus, var(--color-brand-400));\n  transform: rotate(45deg);\n}\n.model-picker__names {\n  display: grid;\n  min-width: 0;\n  flex: 1 1 auto;\n}\n.model-picker__name {\n  overflow: hidden;\n  color: var(--nb-text, var(--color-text-hi));\n  font-weight: 550;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n.model-picker__desc {\n  overflow: hidden;\n  color: var(--nb-secondary, var(--color-text-body));\n  font-size: 10px;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n.model-picker__tag {\n  flex: none;\n  color: var(--nb-secondary, var(--color-text-body));\n  font-size: 10px;\n  text-transform: capitalize;\n}\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n  .model-picker__menu {\n    animation: none;\n  }\n}\n"
}

## Report

**Files edited: `src/components/ui/ModelPicker.css`** (only this file; `ModelPicker.tsx` untouched)

What changed:

1. **Fixed the dropdown's illegibility / blending.** The menu previously painted itself with `background: var(--color-panel)` — an in-page surface that is translucent in glass (`rgb(18 20 24 / 0.72)`) and gloss (`rgb(15 15 15 / 0.35)`), so page content behind the portaled menu bled through. The menu's background, border, radius, shadow, `overflow-y` and `overscroll-behavior` are now supplied by the contract's opaque floating plane (`--nb-menu` plus `--nb-border` / `--nb-radius-sm` / `--nb-shadow` + `--nb-edge`), so I deleted those declarations from this file rather than fighting the token block with `!important`.

2. **Removed the archived `rgb()` chrome rules.** The old `.theme-glass/.theme-gloss .model-picker__menu` block hardcoded `rgba(0,0,0,0.6)` shadows and `14px`/`10px` radii, duplicating what the tokens now express per archetype; deleted, so the file contains **no raw colour literals** for chrome. Archetype differences now flow entirely from tokens — industrial gets 0px radius / no blur / no glow, glass 10px + specular edge, gloss 12px + deepest shadow.

3. **Tokenised all text so labels and descriptions pass contrast.** Option names were `var(--color-text-hi)` and are now `--nb-text`; descriptions, tags and the trigger label were `var(--color-text-body)` and are now `--nb-secondary` — both defined per archetype+mode against the surface they sit on. The active/selected row uses `--nb-selection` (from the contract block) with `--nb-text`, so the label stays readable while tinted.

4. **Two genuine contrast defects corrected:**
   - The selected checkmark used `--color-brand-400`. The accent is user-configurable, and a bright sky accent on a light selection tint fails; it now rides `--nb-focus`, which is tuned per archetype and mode to stay visible on its own surface.
   - The unrecognised-model state (`data-unavailable`) was drawn in accent ink, which is unreadable on light themes. It is now `--nb-text` with a dotted underline, so colour is not the only signal — a behaviour-visible but non-structural change worth an eyeball.

5. Also dropped the chevron's `opacity: 0.7` (it inherits `currentColor`, so it now matches the token ink exactly) and removed a duplicated `.model-picker__error` rule that the contract block and `PromptBar.css` already own.

**Left undone / worth checking by the coordinator:** the menu now relies on `notebook-tokens.css` for its background entirely — correct today because `ModelPicker.tsx` imports it, but if that import is ever dropped the popover renders transparent. I did not add per-archetype `--nb-sheen` to the menu: the contract sets the menu's `background` with `!important`, so a sheen would need a competing `!important` override, and the archetype depth already comes through `--nb-edge`/`--nb-shadow`. Visual confirmation of the dropdown across all six appearances is still needed, since I could not run the contrast audit.

  "content": "import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';\n\n/**\n * The three appearances must be recognisably different, not just legible:\n * Industrial is opaque and square, Liquid Glass is frosted and rounded, and\n * Liquid Gloss is the deepest translucency with the largest radii and a sheen.\n * These assertions read the real rendered surfaces.\n */\n\nconst EXPECTED: Record<string, { radius: number; opaque: boolean; blur: boolean; shadow: boolean; sheen: boolean }> = {\n  industrial: { radius: 0, opaque: true, blur: false, shadow: false, sheen: false },\n  glass: { radius: 16, opaque: false, blur: true, shadow: true, sheen: false },\n  gloss: { radius: 20, opaque: false, blur: true, shadow: true, sheen: true },\n};\n\nconst probe = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => {\n  const panel = document.querySelector('.study-panel') as HTMLElement;\n  const style = getComputedStyle(panel);\n  const alpha = Number((style.backgroundColor.match(/[\\d.]+/g) ?? ['0', '0', '0', '1'])[3] ?? 1);\n  const nonZero = /-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?px/g;\n  const shadowValues = (style.boxShadow.match(nonZero) ?? []).map(parseFloat);\n  return {\n    radius: parseFloat(style.borderTopLeftRadius),\n    alpha,\n    blur: style.backdropFilter !== 'none' && style.backdropFilter !== '',\n    // A shadow with only zero offsets is the transparent no-op the Industrial\n    // archetype uses, so it counts as no shadow.\n    shadow: style.boxShadow !== 'none' && shadowValues.some(v => v !== 0),\n    sheen: style.backgroundImage !== 'none' && style.backgroundImage !== '',\n    tokenBorder: getComputedStyle(panel).getPropertyValue('--nb-border').trim(),\n    tokenHairline: getComputedStyle(panel).getPropertyValue('--nb-hairline').trim(),\n  };\n});\n\nconst open = async (page: Page, theme: string, mode = 'dark') => {\n  await page.goto(`/tests/notebook/study-harness.html?theme=${theme}&mode=${mode}&library`);\n  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Open notebook/ }).first().click();\n  await expect(page.locator('.study-panel')).toHaveCount(3);\n};\n\ntest.describe('archetype differentiation', () => {\n  for (const [theme, expected] of Object.entries(EXPECTED)) {\n    test(`${theme} renders its own shape, surface and depth`, async ({ page }) => {\n      await open(page, theme);\n      const result = await probe(page);\n      expect(result.radius).toBe(expected.radius);\n      expect(result.alpha === 1).toBe(expected.opaque);\n      expect(result.blur).toBe(expected.blur);\n      expect(result.shadow).toBe(expected.shadow);\n      expect(result.sheen).toBe(expected.sheen);\n      // Boundary and divider tokens must stay distinct from each other.\n      expect(result.tokenBorder).not.toBe(result.tokenHairline);\n    });\n  }\n\n  test('the three archetypes are not interchangeable', async ({ page }) => {\n    const seen: unknown[] = [];\n    for (const theme of Object.keys(EXPECTED)) {\n      await open(page, theme);\n      seen.push(await probe(page));\n    }\n    const [industrial, glass, gloss] = seen as Array<{ radius: number; alpha: number; blur: boolean }>;\n    expect(industrial.radius).toBeLessThan(glass.radius);\n    expect(glass.radius).toBeLessThan(gloss.radius);\n    expect(industrial.alpha).toBeGreaterThan(glass.alpha);\n    expect(glass.blur && !industrial.blur).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  test('light and dark resolve different token values for every archetype', async ({ page }) => {\n    for (const theme of Object.keys(EXPECTED)) {\n      await open(page, theme, 'dark');\n      const dark = await probe(page);\n      await open(page, theme, 'light');\n      const light = await probe(page);\n      expect(dark.tokenBorder).not.toBe(light.tokenBorder);\n      expect(dark.alpha === 1).toBe(light.alpha === 1);\n    }\n  });\n});\n"
}
